summary: Concorde International Group Ltd. filed a 6-K disclosing receipt of a Letter of Offer to acquire a majority equity interest in YOOV Group Holding Limited, its wholly owned subsidiary, from an unnamed offeror. No specific terms (stake %, price, premium, dates) are disclosed. The board and management will review the offer and negotiate exclusively. Further details are pending. This is a preliminary-stage partial divestiture; watch for definitive agreement terms, regulatory approvals in Singapore, and potential competitive bids.
